name: Poor Old Blanchy
summary: On Westfall's road, Poor Old Blanchy waits with the stranded Furlbrows, worn out and hungry. Their wagon broke as they fled, and Verna asks you to find oats at nearby abandoned farms to feed the mare.

sections.title: A Stranded Household
sections.body: Verna and Farmer Furlbrow are stranded beside Westfall's main road. Bandits and rogue mechanical harvest golems have driven families like theirs from their homes. The Furlbrows tried to carry their belongings to safety, but their wagon broke down, leaving them marooned in open country.

sections.title: Comfort for a Faithful Mare
sections.body: Old Blanchy has plowed and hauled for the Furlbrow family through many seasons. Now the delay has left the gentle mare exhausted and starving. Verna asks you to search nearby overrun farmsteads for sacks of oats. Hostile threshers and gnoll scavengers threaten there, but the grain could give the faithful mare a decent meal.

faq.answer: Old Blanchy is the Furlbrow family's beloved, aging workhorse. For years she has pulled their plows and carts across Westfall. Now she is exhausted and stranded beside the road after their wagon axle broke.

faq.q: Why is the Furlbrow wagon broken down?
faq.answer: The Furlbrows tried to flee their farm with all their belongings, but the wagon gave out under the strain. They are stranded along the highway, exposed to bandits and prowling beasts.

faq.q: Where do the oats come from?
faq.answer: Sacks of oats lie scattered across the fields and outbuildings of Westfall's overrun farms. Homesteaders left them behind when they fled rogue harvest machines and bandits.

faq.q: What threats guard the grain in the fields?
faq.answer: Southwest of the road, rogue mechanical harvest watchers and bands of Riverpaw gnolls scavenge in deserted barns.

faq.q: Why hasn't the family moved Old Blanchy to safety?
faq.answer: Old Blanchy is spent and starving, unable to pull or travel far without food. The Furlbrows refuse to leave their loyal mare or their belongings behind.

faq.q: Does Stormwind send aid to farmers like the Furlbrows?
faq.answer: Stormwind's royal court offers Westfall's homesteaders almost no protection or aid. Rural folk are largely left to fend for themselves or depend on the struggling People's Militia.

angles.text: The stranded Furlbrows show how rural human subjects suffer neglect while the capital remains paralyzed by political stagnation.
As a hunter, you know that caring for a spent draft animal honors the bond between working folk and the beasts that faithfully bear their burdens.
